segments.name: Insurance as a Service
segments.description: Sells an AI, telematics and computer-vision insurance platform plus brokerage, claims and roadside assistance services to insurers, carmakers and fleets.
segments.evidence: Roadzen has built a pioneering technology platform that uses telematics, computer vision and data science to spearhead innovation across the insurance value chain, namely underwriting, distribution, claims and road safety.

revenueModel.text: Insurers, carmakers and fleets pay brokerage commissions and platform fees for insurance distribution and IaaS technology.
revenueModel.evidence: Roadzen has two principal models for generating revenue: 1) platform sales of our IaaS platform, and 2) brokerage commissions and fees.
